title: Yueyang Tower
visualBrief: Specific standing Yueyang Tower exterior: three decreasing golden curved roofs/strongly upswept corners, rounded upper ridge/finial, dark red/brown timber columns and bracket blocks, open middle balcony/geometric rails, closed upper lattice panels and bounded stone plinth/entrance treads. Four existing shared stone/timber/panel/glazed-tile graphs; original simplified geometry, no copied photos or pseudo-calligraphy. No furnished interior, whole city-wall gate/frontage, adjacent green pavilion, park platform, trees or tourist props.
